messages:
Alex: noticing large spike in prometheus_remote_storage_queue_length on cluster-west-eu-2 (~18k). Grafana alerts: remote_write_queue_high (firing) and remote_write_pending_samples rising.

Maria: on it. Any recent infra/monitoring changes or mass deploys to gpu-workers? Could be cardinality or network flakiness.

Sam: grabbing logs from prometheus-0. Lots of send errors and timeouts. Excerpt: 
```
level=error ts=2026-03-18T14:27:05.123Z caller=remote.go:345 component=remote addr="https://rw-prod.ops:443/api/v1/write" err="post series: Post \"https://rw-prod.ops:443/api/v1/write\": net/http: TLS handshake timeout"
level=warn ts=2026-03-18T14:27:06.456Z caller=remote.go:512 component=remote msg="send samples failed" err="server returned HTTP 408" pending_samples=18342
```

Jen: sounds like backpressure from a cardinality burst plus some TLS/handshake churn. If many series created, remote_write queues balloon and then time out. Can we get top offending label combos? Run: `topk(12, count({job=~"kube-state-metrics|kubernetes-nodes"}) by (pod, metric))` or use `count by (pod_template_hash)`.

Irene: ran quick checks. Culprit: new per-job label injected into GPU worker pods (we started labeling pods with job_run_id for debugging). kube_pod_labels_* and pod_template_hash exploded series in the gpu namespace.

Alex: immediate mitigation: drop these labels before scraping/remote_write and throttle batch sizes so we don't overwhelm the remote receiver. Proposed temporary prometheus config patch:
```
spec:
  remote_write:
  - url: https://rw-prod.ops:443/api/v1/write
    queue_config:
      max_samples_per_send: 500
      capacity: 20000
    timeout: 30s
  metric_relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: ["pod_template_hash"]
    action: labeldrop
  - regex: "kube_pod_labels_.*"
    action: labeldrop
```
Apply via prometheus-operator configmap/CR.

Sam: also recommend `honor_labels: false` for remote_write, and increase client idle_conn_timeout to 60s to cut TLS handshake frequency. But be careful: longer idle connections can hide load balancing issues.

prom-bot: configmap/prometheus-monitoring updated by Jen. Rolling restart applied to prometheus statefulset.

Maria: patch applied at 14:35 UTC. prometheus-0 restarted and reloaded config. Watching metrics now.

Sam: remote_write_queue_length trending down from ~18k -> ~2k within 6 minutes. pending_samples decreasing. TLS handshake errors also dropped after client idle timeout change.

Irene: series count in gpu namespace down ~90% after labeldrop. Verified with `count(series{namespace="gpu-workers"})` comparisons. The per-job label added thousands of distinct series per job.

Jen: opened infra PR to make relabel rules permanent and to add a note in the helm values changelog. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4219

Maria: will also adjust Grafana alert rule to use queue length as a percentage of queue capacity (ratio) instead of an absolute threshold; current alert is too noisy for transient spikes. I'll open an alert PR.

Alex: long-term: we need CI guardrails to prevent unbounded labels (per-job ids) making it into pods for exporters. Also consider adding cardinality checks in our prometheus relabel rules and exporter configs for GPU namespace.

Irene: filing INF-6723 to track: 1) enforce relabeling in helm chart, 2) CI check to block deployments with unbounded labels, 3) evaluate adding a secondary remote_write receiver in region or rate-limiting exporter scrapes.

Sam: we'll monitor for 24h. If queue climbs again we should consider temporary scrape reduction for GPU-heavy exporters or spin up an additional receiver behind rw-prod.

Alex: thanks. Marking thread resolved for now, will follow INF-6723. :white_check_mark:
